$comment: Hand-maintained catalogue of free sample packs and instruments for the 'curated' provider. Every file URL was checked with a plain GET (no cookies) on the 'verified' date; entries without a direct file have downloadable=false and link to their page. Descriptions are our own words. Licence keys point into 'licenses'.

drumgizmo.note: CC BY 4.0. When a kit is used in a release, credit it wherever performers are credited (album credits or similar).

philharmonia.name: Philharmonia sound samples licence
philharmonia.note: Free to use in any music, including commercial releases. The samples must not be sold or shared 'as is' (as samples or as a sampler instrument).

iowa-mis.name: University of Iowa MIS terms
iowa-mis.note: The studio states the recordings 'may be downloaded and used for any projects, without restrictions'.

avl.name: AVL Drumkits licence (CC BY-SA 3.0, music exempt)
avl.note: The kits are CC BY-SA 3.0, but the author states that music made with them can be sold or distributed without credit; share-alike only applies if you modify or redistribute the kits themselves.

adobe.name: Adobe Audition sound effects (Adobe EULA)
adobe.note: Royalty-free content files under the Adobe Audition EULA: usable in your own productions but not redistributable on their own. Adobe does not clearly say whether you need an Adobe licence to use them.

reverb-machine.name: Reverb Machine licence
reverb-machine.note: Use in your own compositions, commercial releases included, without credit. No redistribution, no new sample packs or instruments, and no AI or machine-learning training.

99sounds.name: 99Sounds licence
99sounds.note: Royalty-free for personal and commercial projects, credit optional. No resale or redistribution of the files, and no noise or sleep-sound apps.

goldbaby.name: Goldbaby licence
goldbaby.note: Royalty-free for use in your recordings, commercial releases included. The sounds may not be redistributed in any form.

sonniss.name: Sonniss GDC bundle licence
sonniss.note: Sonniss states the GDC bundles are royalty-free for commercial use with no attribution. Read the licence shipped with the bundle year you download; recent ones may exclude AI training.

legowelt.name: Legowelt sample terms
legowelt.note: Legowelt says the samples are free to download and use in your productions (donations welcome).

bpb.name: Bedroom Producers Blog sample terms
bpb.note: BPB states the samples are royalty-free for your music and sound design. Don't share the pack itself.

packs.title: Philharmonia Orchestra samples: Strings
packs.author: Philharmonia Orchestra
packs.description: Single notes from the orchestra's string section (violin, viola, cello, double bass) across the range, dynamics and playing styles such as arco and pizzicato. MP3 files, one note per file.

packs.title: Philharmonia Orchestra samples: Brass
packs.author: Philharmonia Orchestra
packs.description: Single notes from the brass section (trumpet, trombone, bass trombone, French horn, tuba) at several dynamics and note lengths. MP3 files, one note per file.

packs.title: Philharmonia Orchestra samples: Woodwind
packs.author: Philharmonia Orchestra
packs.description: Single notes from flutes, oboes, clarinets, bassoons, saxophones and their relatives, recorded by Philharmonia players. MP3 files, one note per file.

packs.title: Philharmonia Orchestra samples: Percussion
packs.author: Philharmonia Orchestra
packs.description: Hits from the orchestral percussion section: bass drum, snare, cymbals, tambourine, triangle, woodblocks and more. MP3 files, one note per file.

packs.title: University of Iowa MIS: Violin (2012)
packs.author: University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios (Lawrence Fritts)
packs.description: Chromatic violin notes, bowed (arco) and plucked (pizzicato) on each string, three dynamics, stereo 16-bit/44.1 kHz AIFF recorded in an anechoic chamber.

packs.title: University of Iowa MIS: Classical guitar
packs.author: University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios (Lawrence Fritts)
packs.description: Chromatic nylon-string guitar notes on every string at three dynamics, stereo 16-bit/44.1 kHz AIFF.

packs.title: University of Iowa MIS: Flute
packs.author: University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios (Lawrence Fritts)
packs.description: Chromatic flute notes played with vibrato at pp, mf and ff, mono AIFF from an anechoic chamber.

packs.title: University of Iowa MIS: B-flat trumpet
packs.author: University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios (Lawrence Fritts)
packs.description: Chromatic B-flat trumpet notes with vibrato at three dynamics, mono AIFF.

packs.title: University of Iowa MIS: Marimba
packs.author: University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios (Lawrence Fritts)
packs.description: Marimba notes across the range struck with cord, yarn and rubber mallets (one zip per mallet and dynamic).

packs.title: University of Iowa MIS: Cymbals and hi-hat
packs.author: University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios (Lawrence Fritts)
packs.description: Hi-hat, 18-inch crash, 21-inch ride and splash cymbal hits with sticks at several dynamics and positions.

packs.title: University of Iowa MIS: Hand percussion
packs.author: University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios (Lawrence Fritts)
packs.description: Castanets, claves, guiro, triangles and woodblocks recorded dry, several dynamics each.

packs.title: VSCO 2 Community Edition: 256 and 50 orchestral samples
packs.author: Versilian Studios
packs.description: Two hand-picked subsets of the VSCO 2 CE chamber orchestra as plain WAV files (256 and 50 samples): strings, winds, brass and percussion for quick sketching.

packs.title: VSCO 2 Community Edition (full SFZ library)
packs.author: Versilian Studios
packs.description: A free chamber orchestra library of about 3,000 samples (strings, woodwinds, brass, percussion, keys) mapped as SFZ instruments.
packs.note: Released as GitHub release assets, which the build sandbox could not reach to verify; the page links them.

packs.title: Versilian Community Sample Library (VCSL)
packs.author: Versilian Studios
packs.description: A large CC0 collection of acoustic instruments, mostly percussion and world instruments, plus odd aerophones and keyboards, as WAV with SFZ mappings (about 4 GB).

packs.title: Sonatina Symphonic Orchestra
packs.author: Mattias Westlund (maintained by Peter Eastman)
packs.description: A full symphonic orchestra (strings, woodwinds, brass, percussion, keyboards) as SFZ instruments, still maintained on GitHub.
packs.note: Downloads are GitHub release assets, which the build sandbox could not reach to verify.

packs.title: FreePats: Upright Piano KW
packs.author: FreePats project
packs.description: A sampled upright piano with two velocity layers, as an SFZ instrument with FLAC samples.

packs.title: FreePats: Salamander Grand Piano V3
packs.author: Alexander Holm
packs.description: A Yamaha C5 grand recorded in 16 velocity layers with release and resonance samples, 48 kHz/24-bit FLAC with SFZ mapping.

packs.title: FreePats: Spanish Classical Guitar
packs.author: FreePats project
packs.description: A nylon-string Spanish guitar as an SFZ instrument with FLAC samples.

packs.title: FreePats: Kalimba
packs.author: FreePats project
packs.description: A kalimba recorded with two portable recorders, with round-robin layers, as SFZ with WAV samples.

packs.title: FreePats: Tenor Saxophone
packs.author: FreePats project
packs.description: A tenor saxophone sampled across its range, as an SFZ instrument with FLAC samples.

packs.title: FreePats: Xylophone (medium mallets)
packs.author: FreePats project
packs.description: A xylophone played with medium mallets, as an SFZ instrument with FLAC samples.

packs.title: FreePats: Concert Harp
packs.author: FreePats project
packs.description: A concert harp sampled across its range, as an SFZ instrument with FLAC samples.

packs.title: DrumGizmo DRSKit 2.1
packs.author: DrumGizmo
packs.description: A Pearl and Paiste acoustic kit recorded with multiple microphones for the DrumGizmo plugin, with many velocity layers; suited to jazz through rock. Multichannel WAV with DrumGizmo XML.

packs.title: DrumGizmo CrocellKit 1.1
packs.author: DrumGizmo
packs.description: A large metal and rock kit (five toms, several crashes, chinas and splashes) recorded multi-mic for DrumGizmo. Multichannel WAV with DrumGizmo XML.

packs.title: DrumGizmo MuldjordKit 3
packs.author: DrumGizmo
packs.description: A Tama Superstar rock and metal kit recorded multi-mic for DrumGizmo, the project's original kit. Multichannel WAV with DrumGizmo XML.

packs.title: AVL Drumkits: Black Pearl
packs.author: Glen MacArthur (AV Linux)
packs.description: An acoustic rock kit as an SFZ instrument with all individual WAV samples.

packs.title: AVL Drumkits: Blonde Bop
packs.author: Glen MacArthur (AV Linux)
packs.description: A jazz kit as an SFZ instrument with all individual WAV samples.

packs.title: AVL Drumkits: Red Zeppelin
packs.author: Glen MacArthur (AV Linux)
packs.description: A big classic-rock kit as an SFZ instrument with all individual WAV samples.

packs.title: Adobe Audition sound effects: Foley
packs.author: Adobe
packs.description: Everyday foley: doors, cloth, paper, household objects and handling noises. Uncompressed WAV.

packs.title: Adobe Audition sound effects: Foley footsteps
packs.author: Adobe
packs.description: Footsteps on many surfaces and shoe types, walking and running. Uncompressed WAV.

packs.title: Adobe Audition sound effects: Impacts
packs.author: Adobe
packs.description: Hits, slams and booms for trailers, games and transitions. Uncompressed WAV.

packs.title: Adobe Audition sound effects: Science fiction
packs.author: Adobe
packs.description: Sci-fi effects: lasers, spaceship hums, computer bleeps and futuristic textures. Uncompressed WAV.

packs.title: Adobe Audition sound effects: Cartoon
packs.author: Adobe
packs.description: Comedy and cartoon effects: boings, slides, pops and whistles. Uncompressed WAV.

packs.title: Adobe Audition sound effects: Human elements
packs.author: Adobe
packs.description: Human sounds: breaths, laughs, screams, crowds and other non-verbal voices. Uncompressed WAV.

packs.title: Adobe Audition sound effects: Drones
packs.author: Adobe
packs.description: Long evolving drones and atmospheric beds for underscore and sound design. Uncompressed WAV.

packs.title: TinySOL: isolated orchestral notes
packs.author: Carmine-Emanuele Cella, Daniele Ghisi, Vincent Lostanlen, Fabien Lévy, Joshua Fineberg, Yan Maresz
packs.description: 2,913 single notes from 14 orchestral instruments (strings, woodwinds, brass) in ordinary playing technique, from the IRCAM Studio On Line library, with a CSV of pitch and dynamics.

packs.title: VocalSet: singing voice dataset
packs.author: Julia Wilkins, Prem Seetharaman, Alison Wahl, Bryan Pardo
packs.description: About 10 hours of 20 professional singers performing scales, arpeggios and long tones on five vowels with techniques such as vibrato, belt, breathy and vocal fry.

packs.title: Dagstuhl ChoirSet
packs.author: Sebastian Rosenzweig, Helena Cuesta, Christof Weiß, Frank Scherbaum, Emilia Gómez, Meinard Müller
packs.description: Multitrack recordings of an amateur choir singing two pieces in full choir and quartet settings, with close microphones on each singer.

packs.title: NSynth: 305,979 single notes from 1,006 instruments
packs.author: Google Magenta (Jesse Engel et al.)
packs.description: Four-second 16 kHz notes over the MIDI range at five velocities, from 1,006 acoustic, electronic and synth instruments in 11 families, with JSON labels for pitch, velocity and timbre. Split into test, valid and train archives.

packs.title: Reverb Machine: Synth Sounds Collection
packs.author: Reverb Machine
packs.description: Free synth presets collected from Reverb Machine's sound-recreation articles, for several soft synths.

packs.title: Goldbaby free packs
packs.author: Goldbaby
packs.description: Dozens of free packs from Goldbaby: drum machines (SP-1200, MPC60, 606, 808) run through tape and valves, plus a few synth and percussion sets.
packs.note: Each pack is a MediaFire page (interstitial), not a direct file.

packs.title: Sonniss GDC Game Audio Bundles
packs.author: Sonniss
packs.description: Yearly multi-gigabyte bundles of professional game sound effects donated by many vendors for GDC, 24-bit WAV.
packs.note: The site blocks automated clients (Cloudflare), so downloads are left to the browser.

packs.title: 99Sounds: 99 Sound Effects
packs.author: 99Sounds
packs.description: A general-purpose set of 99 sound effects for video, games and music.

packs.title: 99Sounds: Drum Samples
packs.author: 99Sounds
packs.description: Free drum one-shots from 99Sounds: kicks, snares, hats and percussion.

packs.title: 99Sounds: Foley Sounds
packs.author: 99Sounds
packs.description: Foley recorded in a garage: tools, metal, wood and handling sounds.

packs.title: Legowelt sample packs
packs.author: Legowelt
packs.description: Around 25 free sample packs from Dutch producer Legowelt: his synths (Jupiter-8, Prophet-600, Matrix-1000) and drum machines, 16-bit WAV.
packs.note: Downloads are WeTransfer links that expire and get replaced.

packs.title: BPB Analog Kicks
packs.author: Bedroom Producers Blog
packs.description: 200 kick drums sampled from six analog drum machines and synths, with a Kontakt instrument.
